question: The novel Self-Help Group Bank Linkage Program (SHG-BLP) project which grew into a dominant micro finance model, was piloted by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NABARD.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NABARD **was the organization that piloted the** Self-Help Group Bank Linkage Program** (SHG-BLP) project in India.
 
• NABARD came into existence on **12 July 1982 **by transferring the agricultural credit functions of RBI and refinance functions of the then **Agricultural Refinance and Development Corporation (ARDC)**.
 
• It was dedicated to the service of the nation by the late **Prime Minister Smt. Indira Gandhi on 05 November 1982.**
 
• The SHG-BLP project is a** microfinance model **that involves linking **self-help groups of women **in rural areas with formal financial institutions like banks, to provide them with access to **credit and financial services.**
 
• Full form of NABARD is the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microfinance institutions** (MFIs) are organizations that provide financial services to** low-income individuals or groups **who do not have access to traditional banking services.

 
 
• Any loan amount in India** under one lakh rupees** is regarded as a **microloan.**
 
 
 
• **The Ministry of Finance, Government of India**, has control over the** Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India**, which is a statutory entity.
 
 
• Its job is to** license and oversee** the insurance and reinsurance sectors in India.
 
 
 
• Under the administrative purview of the **Ministry of Finance in the Government of India**, the **Securities and Exchange Board of India **(SEBI) is the regulatory authority for the securities and commodities market in India.
 
 
• SEBI was founded on **April 12, 1988,** as an executive body, and on **January 30, 1992, the SEBI Act, 1992**, granted it legislative authority.
